message.source: Reconnect to Deskflow
message.translation: 重新接入 Deskflow

message.source: Disconnect the Bluetooth session, click Stop idle Bluetooth service, then reconnect to start the two-phone service.
message.translation: 请先断开蓝牙会话，点击「停止空闲蓝牙服务」，再点「连接」启动双手机服务。

message.source: For two BLE phones, start a verified directed service, use the same adapter and a different phone address for each screen, and turn off per-device isolation.
message.translation: 双蓝牙手机需要先启动已核验的定向服务。两台设备使用同一适配器，分别填写手机地址，并关闭设备配置中的蓝牙隔离。

message.source: Working with the selected phone…
message.translation: 正在处理所选手机的文件请求…

message.source: Files & sharing
message.translation: 文件与分享

message.source: Requires companion app 0.1.6 and already-authorized ADB. On the phone share to computer, then refresh here and select files to receive. Select files or drag local files into this window to send them. The phone can keep private copies or automatically publish media and files to user-authorized public storage. No clipboard changes or automatic opening. Limits: 32 files, 1 GiB per file, 2 GiB total.
message.translation: 需要伴侣应用 0.1.6 和已有的已授权 ADB。在手机「分享至电脑」后，在此刷新并选择接收。可点击选择文件，也可将本地文件拖入窗口发送。手机可以保留私有副本，也可以将媒体文件和其他文件自动保存到用户授权的公共位置。不修改剪贴板、不自动打开。最多 32 个文件，单文件 1 GiB，总计 2 GiB。

message.source: Refresh phone shares
message.translation: 刷新手机分享

message.source: Receive selected
message.translation: 接收所选文件

message.source: Send files to phone
message.translation: 发送文件到手机

message.source: Cancel transfer
message.translation: 取消传输

message.source: Drop local files here to send them to the phone
message.translation: 将本地文件拖到这里发送到手机

message.source: Send %1 dropped file(s) to the selected phone?
message.translation: 是否将拖入的 %1 个文件发送到所选手机？

message.source: Choose receive folder (files are not overwritten)
message.translation: 选择接收目录（不覆盖已有文件）

message.source: Select pending phone files to receive, or send files to the phone.
message.translation: 请选择待接收的手机文件，或发送文件到手机。

message.source: Transfer complete. Refresh to check for more phone shares. Received phone files can be saved from the companion app.
message.translation: 传输完成。可刷新查看其他手机分享。手机接收的文件请在伴侣应用中另存。

message.source: Transfer failed. Check the selected ADB target, app version, storage and file permissions. Completed files are kept; incomplete downloads are removed. Retry manually.
message.translation: 传输失败，请检查当前 ADB 目标、应用版本、存储空间和文件权限。已完成的文件保留，不完整的电脑接收文件会删除。请手动重试。

message.source: Transfer cancelled. Already completed files are kept. A file committed on the phone just before cancellation may still appear in its inbox.
message.translation: 传输已取消，已完成的文件保留。取消前刚在手机完成写入的文件仍可能显示在收件箱。

message.source: The file was saved on this computer, but could not be removed from the phone outbox. Do not receive it again; delete its private copy in the app.
message.translation: 文件已保存到电脑，但无法清除手机待发送记录。请勿重复接收，可在手机应用中删除对应私有副本。

message.source: Companion app (optional)
message.translation: 伴侣应用（可选）

message.source: Pause playing media when USB is re-enumerated. Requires authorized ADB; it does not install automatically or resume playback.
message.translation: 用于 USB 重新枚举时暂停手机播放。需要已授权的 ADB；不会自动安装应用，也不会自动恢复播放。

message.source: Select a signed companion APK, or use the bundled APK
message.translation: 选择已签名的伴侣 APK，或使用随包附带的 APK

message.source: Select companion APK
message.translation: 选择伴侣 APK

message.source: Install / update APK
message.translation: 安装 / 更新 APK

message.source: Open phone setup
message.translation: 打开手机端设置

message.source: Check permission
message.translation: 检查授权状态

message.source: Optional. No APK is installed automatically; keyboard and mouse do not require this app.
message.translation: 可选功能，不会自动安装 APK；键鼠连接无需此应用。

message.source: Setting up the selected phone via ADB…
message.translation: 正在通过 ADB 设置当前手机…

message.source: Enter an ADB executable and an explicit phone serial / ADB target first.
message.translation: 请先配置 ADB 程序，并填写明确的手机序列号 / ADB 目标。

message.source: Select a readable signed .apk file first.
message.translation: 请先选择可读取且已签名的 .apk 文件。

message.source: The selected ADB target is unavailable. Enable and authorize USB debugging, or connect wireless ADB first. See the log.
message.translation: 所选 ADB 目标不可用。请开启并授权 USB 调试，或先连接无线 ADB，详情见日志。

message.source: APK installed. Open phone setup and manually enable notification access, then check permission.
message.translation: APK 已安装。请打开手机端设置，手动开启通知使用权后检查授权状态。

message.source: APK installation failed. Check the log for signing, version, platform compatibility, or phone confirmation errors. The existing app was not uninstalled.
message.translation: APK 安装失败。请查看日志中的签名、版本、系统兼容性或手机确认错误；未卸载原有应用。

message.source: Could not query or open the companion app. See the log.
message.translation: 无法查询或打开伴侣应用，详情见日志。

message.source: The companion app is not installed for the current user. Install the APK first.
message.translation: 当前用户尚未安装伴侣应用，请先安装 APK。

message.source: Phone setup opened. Tap its notification-access button and enable deskflow-bridge manually.
message.translation: 已打开手机端设置。请点击应用内的通知使用权按钮，手动启用 deskflow-bridge。

message.source: Notification access is enabled. This does not verify that the service is running or that unplug-to-pause works; test on the phone.
message.translation: 通知使用权已开启。此结果不代表服务正在运行或拔出暂停已生效，仍需手机实测。

message.source: Installed, but notification access is not enabled. Open phone setup to grant it manually.
message.translation: 已安装，但尚未开启通知使用权。请打开手机端设置手动授权。

message.source: BLE session release timed out; the GUI-owned provider was stopped. GATT continuity was lost.
message.translation: BLE 会话释放超时，已停止此 GUI 创建的服务，GATT 连续性已丢失。

message.source: Stop the idle Bluetooth service under Shared server, then reconnect to apply the new phone, program, TLS or ADB settings.
message.translation: 请在「共享服务」停止空闲蓝牙服务，然后重新接入，以应用新的手机、程序、TLS 或 ADB 设置。

message.source: Session disconnected; Windows GATT and phone subscriptions are retained until service stop or GUI exit.
message.translation: 会话已断开，Windows GATT 与手机订阅继续保留，直到停止服务或退出 GUI。

message.source: Reusing the retained Windows GATT provider for this session.
message.translation: 本次会话复用已保留的 Windows GATT 服务。

message.source: The retained Windows BLE provider exited; GATT continuity was lost.
message.translation: 保留的 Windows BLE 进程已退出，GATT 连续性已丢失。

message.source: Bluetooth LE (Windows, experimental)
message.translation: 低功耗蓝牙（Windows，实验性）

message.source: Start the Bluetooth service under Shared server, then pair or connect to this PC from the phone.
message.translation: 在「共享服务」中启动蓝牙服务，再从手机蓝牙设置配对或连接这台电脑。

message.source: Start the Bluetooth service under Shared server, then connect to Deskflow Bridge from the phone.
message.translation: 在「共享服务」中启动蓝牙服务，再从手机蓝牙设置连接 Deskflow Bridge。

message.source: Start Bluetooth service
message.translation: 启动蓝牙服务

message.source: Stop idle Bluetooth service
message.translation: 停止空闲蓝牙服务

message.source: This unregisters GATT and loses subscription continuity. The phone may need a Bluetooth reconnect or cache recovery afterward. Other active sessions cannot be stopped here. Continue?
message.translation: 这会注销 GATT 并失去订阅连续性，之后手机可能需要重新连接蓝牙或恢复缓存。此操作不会停止其他活动会话。是否继续？

message.source: Idle Bluetooth service stop acknowledged.
message.translation: 空闲蓝牙服务已确认停止请求。

message.source: Bluetooth service could not be stopped:
message.translation: 无法停止蓝牙服务：

message.source: USB (AOA HID)
message.translation: USB（AOA HID）

message.source: ADB + UHID (USB / wireless)
message.translation: ADB＋UHID（USB／无线）

message.source: ADB + UHID (recommended on Windows)
message.translation: ADB＋UHID（Windows 推荐）

message.source: ADB enabled (required for UHID)
message.translation: 已启用 ADB（UHID 必需）

message.source: ADB target (required)
message.translation: ADB 目标（必填）

message.source: Authorized USB ADB serial or wireless host:port; no USB serial fallback
message.translation: 已授权的 USB ADB 序列号或无线 host:port；不回退使用 USB 序列号

message.source: Enter ADB target manually
message.translation: 手动填写 ADB 目标

message.source: ADB device and oriented screen size detected. Adjust dimensions if needed, or connect.
message.translation: 已识别 ADB 设备及当前方向的屏幕尺寸，可调整尺寸或连接。

message.source: Enable USB debugging and authorize this computer, then refresh and select the phone or enter its ADB target. UHID keeps the absolute pointer and uses normal ADB drivers. Android must support /dev/uhid. No video or companion app is required.
message.translation: 开启 USB 调试并授权本电脑，刷新选择手机或填写 ADB 目标。UHID 保留绝对坐标指针，使用正常 ADB 驱动；手机系统须支持 /dev/uhid。无需投屏或伴侣应用。

message.source: Starting ADB/scrcpy and creating UHID keyboard and pointer…
message.translation: 正在启动 ADB／scrcpy 并创建 UHID 键盘与指针…

message.source: UHID descriptors sent; waiting for Deskflow handshake.
message.translation: UHID 描述符已发送，等待 Deskflow 握手。

message.source: UHID is unavailable in this build. Enable BUILD_UHID.
message.translation: 当前构建未提供 UHID，请启用 BUILD_UHID。

message.source: Bluetooth LE (Linux)
message.translation: 低功耗蓝牙（Linux）

message.source: Connection type
message.translation: 连接方式

message.source: Bluetooth service
message.translation: 蓝牙服务

message.source: Uses the system's default Bluetooth adapter.
message.translation: 使用系统默认蓝牙适配器。

message.source: Bluetooth adapter
message.translation: 蓝牙适配器

message.source: Automatically connect discovered phones to Deskflow
message.translation: 蓝牙连接后自动接入 Deskflow

message.source: Bluetooth service discovery starts automatically. When enabled, a paired phone is attached to Deskflow after it connects.
message.translation: 蓝牙服务会自动启动并发现手机。开启后，已配对手机连接成功会自动接入 Deskflow。

message.source: Temporarily use BLE-only mode (administrator authentication)
message.translation: 临时使用仅 BLE 模式（需要管理员认证）

message.source: Keyboard and mouse compatibility for older Android
message.translation: 兼容旧版 Android 蓝牙键鼠

message.source: Use low HID handles for older phones that connect but do not activate the keyboard and mouse. Stop the idle Bluetooth service before changing this option.
message.translation: 如果旧手机连上后键鼠仍未就绪，可使用较低的 HID 句柄。更改前请先停止空闲蓝牙服务。

message.source: Confirm Bluetooth mode change
message.translation: 确认切换蓝牙模式

message.source: BLE-only service startup was cancelled.
message.translation: 已取消启动仅 BLE 服务。

message.source: Starting the shared BLE-only service on %1. Complete administrator authentication to continue.
message.translation: 正在 %1 上启动共享的仅 BLE 服务。请完成管理员认证。

message.source: Stop the existing Bluetooth service once it is idle, then reconnect to start a verified BLE-only service.
message.translation: 请等现有蓝牙服务空闲后手动停止它，再重新连接以启动已核验的仅 BLE 服务。

message.source: Verify the running BlueZ instance before starting the two-phone Bluetooth service.
message.translation: 请先核验当前运行的 BlueZ 实例，再启动双机蓝牙服务。

message.source: All Bluetooth connections on %1, including keyboards, mice and headphones, will disconnect. Use a wired keyboard/mouse or a dedicated adapter. Administrator authentication is required. Original settings will be restored when the session ends; failed recovery retains a snapshot for --ble-restore. Continue?
message.translation: %1 上的所有蓝牙连接（包括键盘、鼠标、耳机）将断开。请使用有线键鼠或专用适配器。接下来需要管理员认证。会话结束时恢复原设置；恢复失败会保留快照，可用 --ble-restore 显式恢复。是否继续？

message.source: Waiting for the target phone's HID connection (pair/connect in Bluetooth settings)
message.translation: 等待目标手机 HID 就绪（请在系统蓝牙设置中配对或连接）

message.source: Bluetooth/Deskflow disconnected — waiting to reconnect; pairing retained
message.translation: 蓝牙或 Deskflow 已断开，等待重新连接；配对保留

message.source: Waiting for the privileged Bluetooth supervisor to restore settings. It will not be forcibly killed; check the log if recovery fails.
message.translation: 正在等待蓝牙权限监督进程恢复设置，不会强杀该进程；恢复失败请查看日志。

message.source: Bluetooth LE is unavailable on this platform or in this build.
message.translation: 当前平台或构建未提供低功耗蓝牙支持。

message.source: The Bluetooth service is busy or its cleanup is incomplete. Stop the other session or recover it explicitly.
message.translation: 蓝牙服务已有会话或清理尚未完成，请结束另一会话或显式恢复。

message.source: The Bluetooth service uses a different keyboard and mouse compatibility setting. Stop the idle Bluetooth service, then reconnect.
message.translation: 蓝牙服务的键鼠兼容设置不同。请停止空闲蓝牙服务后重新连接。

message.source: Could not launch the Bluetooth service (%1).
message.translation: 无法启动蓝牙服务（%1）。

message.source: Could not verify that the Bluetooth service is available. See the service log at %1.
message.translation: 未能确认蓝牙服务可用。请查看服务日志 %1。

message.source: Starting the resident Bluetooth service as the current user. It stays running across sessions and GUI exits to preserve phone subscriptions.
message.translation: 正在以当前用户启动常驻蓝牙服务；会话断开和 GUI 退出后仍保留，以维持手机订阅。

message.source: USB auto-connect is using hotplug event notifications.
message.translation: USB 自动连接已启用热插拔事件通知。

message.source: USB hotplug notifications are unavailable or stopped; auto-connect is using 2-second polling.
message.translation: USB 热插拔通知不可用或监听已停止，自动连接已回退为每 2 秒轮询。

message.source: Automatically connect this device when USB is inserted
message.translation: USB 插入时自动连接此设备

message.source: No USB debugging required. Remembers each successfully connected phone and its settings. Keep the app running, including in the tray. After a manual disconnect or failure, unplug and reinsert USB to retry.
message.translation: 无需 USB 调试。记住每台成功连接过的手机及其配置。需保持程序运行（可驻留托盘）。手动断开或连接失败后，拔插 USB 才会再次自动连接。

message.translation: 手动剪贴板

message.translation: 与选中的手机传输纯文本。需要已授权的 ADB 连接。

message.translation: %1 · 手机剪贴板没有可读取的文本。请解锁手机并复制一段文本。

message.translation: %1 · 无法确认发送结果，请检查手机剪贴板。

message.translation: %1 · 剪贴板文本超过 262,130 字节上限。

message.translation: %1 · 请检查这台手机是否已在 ADB 中上线并授权。

message.translation: %1 · 缺少有效的 scrcpy 服务端或其版本文件。

message.translation: %1 · 无法连接手机剪贴板。

message.translation: 正在截取 %1 的画面…

message.translation: 截取这台手机的当前画面，复制到本机剪贴板。需要已授权的 ADB 连接。

message.source: Screenshot from %1 copied. Paste it into a chat or document.
message.translation: 已复制 %1 的截图，可以粘贴到聊天或文档。

message.source: Could not start ADB to capture %1. Check the ADB executable path.
message.translation: 无法启动 ADB 来截取 %1 的画面，请检查 ADB 程序路径。

message.source: Screenshot from %1 failed. Authorize this computer for debugging on the phone.
message.translation: 无法截取 %1 的画面，请先在手机上授权这台电脑调试。

message.source: Could not capture %1. Check that the selected ADB device is online and authorized.
message.translation: 无法截取 %1 的画面，请确认所选 ADB 设备在线且已授权。

message.source: No complete PNG screenshot was received from %1. The clipboard was not changed.
message.translation: 未收到 %1 的完整 PNG 截图，剪贴板内容未更改。

message.translation: %1 的截图过大，未更改剪贴板内容。

message.source: Timed out waiting for a screenshot from %1. The clipboard was not changed.
message.translation: 等待 %1 的截图超时，剪贴板内容未更改。

message.source: For wired ADB + UHID. Authorize USB debugging and connect this phone successfully once. Keep the app running; after a manual disconnect or failure, reinsert the cable to retry.
message.translation: 用于有线 ADB＋UHID。请先授权 USB 调试并成功连接此手机一次。保持程序运行；手动断开或连接失败后，重新插线可再试。

message.source: Wired UHID auto-connect could not read the ADB device list. Check the ADB executable; scanning will continue.
message.translation: 有线 UHID 自动连接无法读取 ADB 设备列表。请检查 ADB 程序路径，稍后会继续检测。

message.translation: 检测到 USB 手机 %1，正在使用已记住的配置连接。

message.source: USB auto-connect scan failed. Check bridge installation, USB permissions and drivers; scanning will continue.
message.translation: USB 自动连接扫描失败，请检查桥接程序、USB 权限和驱动；程序将继续检测。

message.source: Using remembered phone settings without ADB. Adjust dimensions manually if the screen orientation has changed.
message.translation: 已恢复手机配置，无需 ADB。若屏幕方向已改变，请手动调整宽高。

message.source: Side-button swipe distance must be between 1% and 100%.
message.translation: 侧键滑动距离必须在 1%～100% 之间。

message.source: Unlock PIN must be empty or contain 4 to 32 digits (0-9) only.
message.translation: 解锁 PIN 必须留空或仅包含 4～32 位数字（0～9）。

message.source: TLS is enabled, but the trusted server fingerprint is missing. Enter a SHA-256 fingerprint or select a fingerprint database file.
message.translation: 已启用 TLS，但未配置可信的服务端指纹。请填写 SHA-256 指纹或选择指纹数据库文件。

message.source: Both a TLS server fingerprint and a fingerprint database file are set. Keep only one of them.
message.translation: 同时配置了 TLS 服务端指纹和指纹数据库文件。请只保留其中一项。

message.source: Phone screen name is invalid. Use 1 to 63 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens; start with a letter, digit or underscore.
message.translation: 手机屏幕名称无效。请使用 1～63 位英文字母、数字、下划线、点或连字符，首位必须为英文字母、数字或下划线。

message.source: Computer screen name is invalid. Use 1 to 63 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens; start with a letter, digit or underscore.
message.translation: 电脑屏幕名称无效。请使用 1～63 位英文字母、数字、下划线、点或连字符，首位必须为英文字母、数字或下划线。

message.source: Deskflow server address is empty. Enter the server's host name or IP address.
message.translation: Deskflow 服务端地址为空。请填写服务端主机名或 IP 地址。

message.source: Deskflow server address contains spaces or control characters. Enter only the host name or IP address; set the port separately.
message.translation: Deskflow 服务端地址含空格或控制字符。请只填写主机名或 IP 地址，端口在端口栏单独设置。

message.source: Deskflow server address is too long. Use at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.
message.translation: Deskflow 服务端地址过长。UTF-8 编码后不能超过 1024 字节。

message.source: Deskflow server port must be between 1 and 65535.
message.translation: Deskflow 服务端端口必须在 1～65535 之间。

message.source: Mouse movement multiplier must be a finite number between 1 and 10.
message.translation: 鼠标移动倍率必须是 1～10 之间的有限数值。

message.source: Relative mouse mode requires a movement multiplier of 1. Reset the multiplier or select absolute mode.
message.translation: 相对鼠标模式要求移动倍率为 1。请恢复倍率为 1，或改用绝对模式。

message.source: Phone screen width must be between 1 and 32767.
message.translation: 手机屏幕宽度必须在 1～32767 之间。

message.source: Phone screen height must be between 1 and 32767.
message.translation: 手机屏幕高度必须在 1～32767 之间。

message.source: Bluetooth adapter is invalid. Use hci followed by an index from 0 to 65534, for example hci0 (at most five digits).
message.translation: 蓝牙适配器无效。请使用 hci 加 0～65534 的编号，例如 hci0（编号最多五位）。

message.source: Bluetooth isolation is not supported on Windows. Disable Bluetooth isolation.
message.translation: Windows 不支持蓝牙隔离。请关闭蓝牙隔离选项。

message.source: Windows Bluetooth LE only supports the default adapter. Clear the Bluetooth adapter field.
message.translation: Windows 低功耗蓝牙仅支持默认适配器。请清空蓝牙适配器栏。

message.source: Select a server configuration exported from Deskflow under Shared server, or turn off automatic startup.
message.translation: 请在「共享服务」选择从 Deskflow 导出的服务端配置，或关闭自动启动。

message.source: Could not read the Deskflow configuration file at %1.
message.translation: 无法读取 Deskflow 配置文件 %1。

message.source: Deskflow executable is empty. Select the installed deskflow-core or deskflow-server under Shared server.
message.translation: Deskflow 程序路径为空。请在共享服务中选择已安装的 deskflow-core 或 deskflow-server。

message.source: Audio/clipboard runtime files are missing: scrcpy-server or SCRCPY_VERSION.txt. Rebuild or reinstall the complete GUI.
message.translation: 缺少音频/剪贴板运行文件：scrcpy-server 或 SCRCPY_VERSION.txt。请重新构建或安装完整 GUI。

message.source: Port already in use. Stop the existing Deskflow server, change the port, or connect to an existing server.
message.translation: 端口已被占用：停止原 Deskflow 服务、修改端口，或选择连接已有服务。

message.source: Could not detect Deskflow startup arguments: %1
message.translation: 无法检测 Deskflow 启动参数：%1

message.source: [Deskflow argument detection]
message.translation: [Deskflow 参数检测]

message.source: Computer and phone names must differ and contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens.
message.translation: 电脑/手机名称必须不同，且仅包含字母、数字、下划线、点或连字符。

message.source: Could not write Deskflow startup settings.
message.translation: 无法写入 Deskflow 启动设置。

message.source: This Deskflow startup interface cannot explicitly disable TLS. Connect to an existing server instead.
message.translation: 此 Deskflow 启动接口无法显式关闭 TLS，请使用连接已有服务模式。

message.source: This Deskflow startup interface cannot enable TLS. Connect to an existing server instead.
message.translation: 此 Deskflow 启动接口无法显式开启 TLS，请使用连接已有服务模式。

message.source: Unrecognized Deskflow startup interface. Select deskflow-core / deskflow-server, or connect to an existing server.
message.translation: 未识别的 Deskflow 启动接口。请选择 deskflow-core / deskflow-server，或连接已有服务。

message.translation: 已连接 — 将鼠标移到手机一侧即可控制

message.source: Only one BLE phone is supported. Stop the other BLE session and its idle Windows provider first.
